source: retail Need For Speed SHIFT v1.02 / Ghidra SHIFT.exe.c + x86 disassembly

facts.claim: MultiMatrix construction copies every serialized local MATRIX into the matching world slot, including slot 0.
HIERARCHY update copies the caller-provided 0x40-byte matrix into world slot 0 before FUN_006b1620.
LOD update copies the caller-provided 0x40-byte matrix into world slot 0 before FUN_006b1620.
SceneGraph transform dispatch forwards its second argument in EDX to object vfunc +0x2c; when deferred mode is active it enqueues update type 4.
SceneGraph queued update type 4 reserves an xform index and copies exactly 0x40 bytes from the supplied matrix into the xform pool via FUN_00401d10.
SceneGraph flush resolves queued type-4 matrix as xform_pool + index*0x40 in EDX and calls the queued object's vfunc +0x2c.
Binary SGB NODE loading creates scene descriptors and decodes object payloads but does not itself perform a SceneGraph transform dispatch.
